additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this regular time series.

channel._instruction: Enter all channels used for this regular time series.

dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the file or file bundle in which the recorded data is stored.

internalIdentifier._instruction: Enter the identifier (or label) of this regular time series that is used within the corresponding data files to identify this regular time series.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name for this regular time series.

previousRegularTimeSeries._instruction: If this regular time series is part of a sequence of regular time seriess (e.g., multiple repetitions or sweeps), add the regular time series preceding this regular time series.

samplingFrequency._instruction: Enter the sampling frequency of this regular time series.
